wth.text: Crovax is a cursed nobleman who tells of his family being killed and his ancestors fed on, and he accepts a place aboard the Weatherlight rather than stay with his rotting family.
When Phyrexians attack his estate, Rofellos is killed and Gerrard quits the Weatherlight, and Starke's lie that Selenia is held on Rath lures Crovax from the ship.

Mirri throws herself in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and Crovax slays Selenia, but later Mirri sees him sabotaging the sails, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden, where he kills her.

tmp.text: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia, but Phyrexian agents slaughter his family.
On Rath he watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed, while Volrath vows to bind him with pain.

Crovax kills Selenia, which triggers a curse that turns him into a vampire, and later he returns to the Stronghold and slaughters all the hostages before defeating Volrath in a duel after Ertai interferes.

sth.text: Crovax shatters the artifact binding Selenia, who flies away, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
On Rath he sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down, and when he tears apart a shapeshifter in her guise his rage is horrifying.
He then strikes down the real Selenia, whose shards warp him into a vampire, and kills Mirri after they fall into Volrath's garden.

Taken to Phyrexia, he is compleated and groomed as evincar of Rath, defeating Greven, impaling 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes and forcing Belbe to name him evincar before he defeats Volrath thanks to Ertai.

exo.text: Crovax is left with wounds in his soul that Selenia tore and will not close, and a change comes over him as his bloodlust threatens the ship.

nem.text: Crovax is chosen by Phyrexia to take Volrath's place and rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest, then organizes a coup and forces Belbe to crown him evincar.
He announces that things are going to change, orders enemies killed and fed to new recruits, and impales dissenting tribal leaders on flowstone spikes to consolidate power.
Crovax executes Volrath, buries Belbe and has Ertai compleated, and after the Rathi Overlay he oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
He leads the counterattack against Multani's Yavimaya, but Gerrard slices him in half and Selenia recovers his normal soul.

inv.text: Crovax, now evincar, oversees the Rathi Overlay as Rath's Phyrexian legions arrive on Dominaria, and he punishes Tsabo Tavoc by killing her for failing at Koilos.
He takes Gerrard to Phyrexia, where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
When the Coalition storms the Stronghold, Gerrard kills Crovax in the throne room.

pls.text: Crovax tells Ertai he will kill him a hundred times a day as Yawgmoth's reward, and Sisay crashes the Predator into his stronghold.
Crovax cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc, and when Ertai teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold, Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.

plc.text: Crovax is a noble destined for an angel's curse, though in one warped timeline he is redeemed instead, and he flees weeping when he senses Mirri is not ready for the curse taking hold of her.
Starke lies to Crovax and then admits the letter was a trick to draw him away from his family, so Crovax realizes he left them alone and stumbles off, cursed.
Later Crovax helps rescue Starke from Maraxus's camp, and Gerrard sends him to the ship while he faces Maraxus alone.
